note: Item codes are the .sav column names, unchanged by data/ecuador_2011_safety.do (Table 5, local survey_cols I51501 I51502 I51533 I51504 ... I51514). The .sav variable labels tie all 14 codes to form q.5.15 options 01-14 by content and column position (I51501. Fiscalia ... I51514. Medios de Comunicacion), 14/14. The third code is I51533, not I51503, in the source file itself; its label (I51533. Direccion nacional antinarcoticos), column position 3 and counts identify it as form option 03. Words from the official Spanish questionnaire, verbatim including the form space before each closing ?; where labels are abbreviated (I51504 truncated, I51507 Comisarias de la Mujer, I51508 MInisterio del Interior) the form wording ships. The form sub-heading POLICIA NACIONAL: spans options 02-06 and ships as section_prompt of section _2; the others are section _1 with a blank prompt. instructions joins the form scale line and the 5.15 question stem with one space, no punctuation added; the interviewer line ANOTE EL CODIGO CORRESPONDIENTE PARA CADA OPCION (RM) is not shipped. Resp: .sav value labels 1=Ninguna confianza, 2..9 labelled only by their own digit, 10=Total confianza, 97=No aplica, 99=No responde; the do-file maps the label strings to 1..10 and drops 97/99. Points 2-9 have no verbal label in form or file, so their option_text is blank. Route 9 by server-side GROUP BY (no export): live per-item x resp counts equal the .sav counts in 140/140 cells, and the 14 count vectors are mutually distinct. English _translated columns are machine translation by this project.
public_note: The English in the _translated columns is an IRW machine translation of the Spanish INEC questionnaire, and item I51533 is the source file's own name for form option 03 (Dirección Nacional Antinarcóticos); there is no I51503.
